description: The app's own commands, restricted to the main webview loaded from a local origin. Deliberately NOT merged into `default`: that capability uses `windows: ["main"]`, and `resolve_access` matches `webviews` OR `windows`, so a window-scoped grant also covers the `browser-tile` child webview (an arbitrary user-chosen remote page). Naming `webviews` and omitting `windows` is the fine-grained form Tauri's own docs recommend on multiwebview windows, and it means an app command needs BOTH the `main` webview label AND a local origin.
